preamble: Chapter rule: Fish, crustaceans, molluscs and other aquatic invertebrates shall be deemed originating even if they were cultivated from nonoriginating fry or larvae. For purposes of this rule, the term “fry” means immature fish at a post-larval stage and includes fingerlings, parr, smolts, and elvers.

rules.label: Rule
rules.text: A change to headings 0301 through 0307 from any other chapter.
